Must use j not in {0,1728} and report |H| mod 3,4. (5) Random and interval controls are weak nulls: need a multiplicative-structure-preserving non-subgroup control (coset c*H on twisted curve, or H with a few random elements swapped, or union of 2 cosets) and an additive-structure control (AP in x) to separate 'subgroup' from 'any structured set'. T_3 near mu~ is an equidistribution (null) result: it can only certify NO excess relations; it cannot show B*D^2 << N (BRIEF rule 5). The idea is a theory/ceiling statement; the falsifier can only kill it (super-generic excess), not support it. Metric (T_3 count, a structural quantity) is acceptable, not wall time.
